text: Recollect 是 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与指令管理插件，为会话加载 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md 及规则文件，并提供按项目保存的持久记忆。它通过系统提示注入指令和记忆索引，支持记忆读写、搜索召回、暂停记忆、导入 Claude Code 记忆以及设置面板。适合希望在不同模型与会话间沿用项目背景和工作偏好的 DSH 用户。默认使用本地文件，无需额外配置 API 密钥；可选召回模式会使用当前模型路由。

Recollect adds CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md instructions and persistent project memory to DSH. It injects guidance and a memory index, with memory tools, optional recall, pause controls, and Claude Code import. Project notes carry across sessions and models. It uses local files and needs no API key.
想让 DSH 在每次会话开始时自动读取项目里的 CLAUDE.md 和 AGENTS.md。
希望把长期项目背景保存在本地，让不同模型都能接着使用。
需要根据当前对话从记忆文件里找出相关内容并补进上下文。
想把 Claude Code 已有的记忆导入 DSH，并先预览会复制哪些文件。
Load layered CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md instructions into every DSH session.
Keep project memory across sessions and let agents read or update Markdown memory files.
Find relevant local memory notes from a user message and inject them into the conversation.
Import existing Claude Code memory files into a DSH project, with a dry-run preview.
Recollect 的「分层指令加载」功能：会按组织、用户、项目到本地的顺序读取 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md 和规则文件，并将内容注入会话；触发时机包括会话启动、恢复及相关文件访问。
Recollect 的「项目持久记忆」功能：按项目目录保存 MEMORY.md 索引和记忆主题文件，让后续会话可继续使用；模型可通过内置文件操作或专用记忆工具读写。
Recollect 的「相关记忆召回」功能：启用后根据用户消息检索本地记忆，最多选择五份相关文件并以提示块加入对话；可使用 BM25 或模型选择方式。
Recollect 的「记忆导入」功能：通过 /memory-import 将 Claude Code 项目记忆复制到当前记忆目录；支持 all 和 --dry-run 预览，并处理冲突与共享项目。

**换一个模型，记忆也不会丢。**

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Recollect：Recollect 是 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的插件：一套**兼容 Claude Code 的记忆系统**。它沿用 Claude Code 的约定：按目录分层的 `CLAUDE.md`、`@import`、`.claude/rules`，以及以 `MEMORY.md` 为索引的持久记忆。DeepSeek、GPT、Qwen、Claude 等所有模型都拿到同一套完整的记忆指导，不会因为换了模型就被降级。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 为什么需要它：在 Claude Code 里，记忆写作指导会随模型变化：不在它模型目录里的模型只能拿到一段很短的说明，"长期积累"、"用户说记住就立即保存"、各类型的示例都被删掉了。这类模型因此很少主动写记忆。Recollect 用自己编写的提示词（中文和英文两套）和完全一样的行为约定，让每个模型都能：

- 在合适的时机**主动记录**用户画像、工作方式反馈、项目背景和外部资源指针；
- 每个会话开始时读到记忆索引，并在需要时读取或召回记忆正文；
- 记忆会过期，所以推荐之前先核验。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 与 Claude Code 的兼容范围：| 内容 | 兼容程度 |
| --- | --- |
| 指令文件 | **直接读取同一份文件**：`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`、`~/.claude/rules/`、项目里的 `CLAUDE.md`、`.claude/CLAUDE.md`、`.claude/rules/`、`CLAUDE.local.md`、`@import`、`/etc/claude-code`。另外还会读取 `AGENTS.md` |
| 记忆格式 | **一致**：每条记忆一个文件，带 frontmatter（`name`、`description`、`metadata.type`），四种类型，`MEMORY.md` 作索引 |
| 记忆存储 | **默认分开存放**：Recollect 写在 `~/.dsh/memory/projects/<slug>/`，Claude Code 写在 `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/`。两边的 slug 计算规则相同 |
| 已有的 Claude Code 记忆 | 用 `/memory-import` 复制过来（`all` 导入全部项目，`--dry-run` 只预览）。来源只读，不会覆盖已有文件，索引按链接去重后合并 |
| 共用同一份记忆 | 可选全局共用（`memory.shareWithClaudeCode: true`）或按项目共用（`memory.shareProjects`）。面板中的「与 Claude Code 共用本项目」开关控制当前项目；「预览导入 → 确认导入」按钮用于一次性复制。共用时两边会修改同一批文件，Claude Code 的后台整理也会整理它们 |
| 未实现 | 团队记忆（`CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES`）、账号记忆、`#` 快捷写入 |

text:
@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 安装：| DSH 版本 | Recollect 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` 及以后（含官方桌面版；已测 `0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.5`） | `0.5.0` |

**官方桌面版：** 在插件页安装 npm 包 `@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect`，或在 Git 地址一栏填写 `https://github.com/kirkchinese/DSH-Recollect.git`，然后按提示重启。

**命令行与 Web：**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kirkchinese/dsh-recollect@0.5.0
```

也可以从仓库安装某个发布标签：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/kirkchinese/DSH-Recollect.git#v0.5.0"
```
@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 安装：安装后重启 DSH 并刷新页面，新会话生效。Recollect 会接管指令文件的加载，并自动过滤 DSH 自带的 AGENTS.md 加载器注入的内容，避免同一份文件被读两次。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 在 Windows 上安装：在 PowerShell 中通过 npm 包安装（官方桌面版也可以在插件页填写同一个 npm 包名）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect@0.5.0"
```

安装后重启 DSH 并刷新页面。已知的平台差异：

- 后台提取和 dream 的子代理只放行 bash 只读命令（以及受限的记忆删除命令）；Windows 上 DSH 使用 pwsh，因此它们不能运行 shell 命令。这两个功能默认关闭；常规记忆读写、共用与导入不受此限制。
- `instructions.managedDirs` 默认是 `/etc/claude-code`，Windows 通常没有这个目录；需要组织策略时改成实际存在的绝对目录。
- slug 与 Claude Code 使用同一规则：`C:\Users\me\proj` 会变成 `C--Users-me-proj`，按项目共用时能匹配同一份记忆。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 版本支持策略：`engines.dsh` 只设下限 `>=0.2.0-rc.2`，DSH peer 依赖也使用开放范围，因此新的 DSH rc 不会被安装检查拦下。如果宿主接口变化，相关功能会报错，而不是因为版本上限导致整个插件被拒绝加载。CI 覆盖上表两个已测宿主版本，以及 Linux / Windows；开放范围并不代表未来接口永远不变。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 它做什么：| 功能 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 指令文件 | 开 | 按层级加载：组织策略 `/etc/claude-code` → 用户（`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`、`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`、`~/.agents/AGENTS.md`、`~/.claude/rules`）→ 从根目录到当前目录逐层加载 `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md`（`@import` 就地展开，最多 4 层）→ `.claude/CLAUDE.md` → rules（递归 `.md`）→ `CLAUDE.local.md`/`AGENTS.local.md`。各层并列拼接，不截断；单个文件超过 4 MiB 时跳过 |
| 持久记忆 | 开 | system prompt 里放完整的记忆写作指导：四种类型、不该存什么、两步保存法、访问与核验规则。首条消息注入 `MEMORY.md` 索引，超过 200 行或 25 000 字符时截断并附警告 |
| 刷新 | 开 | resume 时只注入发生变化的文件；上下文压缩把指令摘要掉以后整份重新注入；切换目录或暂停、恢复记忆时也会刷新 |
| 子目录发现 | 开 | 读写子目录里的文件时，注入该目录的指令文件，以及 frontmatter 里 `paths:` 匹配的条件 rule |
| 写后检查 | 开 | 写入记忆后立即提醒：索引超限、单个文件超过召回上限、缺少 `description`、出现 `-2` 式的续写文件 |
| 召回 | 关 | 每次提问时检索最多 5 条相关记忆正文。`bm25` 在本地检索，支持中英日韩；`selector` 用一次模型调用挑选 |
| 后台提取 | 关 | 每轮结束后由一个分叉的子智能体补写主对话漏记的内容，写入范围被限制在记忆目录内 |
| 整理（dream） | 关 | 距上次整理超过 24 小时、且期间有 5 个以上会话时，合并、修正和精简记忆目录。也可以用 `/dream` 手动触发 |
| 智能体记忆 | 关 | 给指定预设的智能体一份独立记忆，作用域为 `user`、`project` 或 `local` |

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 它做什么：记忆存放在 `~/.dsh/memory/projects/<git 根目录对应的 slug>/`，同一仓库的不同子目录和 worktree 共用一份。

**写入方式会自动适配沙箱。** 沙箱允许写记忆目录时，模型直接用内置的 `write`/`edit`；在 `workspace-write` 等模式下记忆目录位于工作区之外，Recollect 会挂载专用工具 `memory_list/read/write/edit/delete`，指导文本也随之切换。这些工具只能写记忆目录里的 `.md` 文件，并会拒绝写入密钥。只读沙箱下不写记忆。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 设置页：有两个入口：「设置」弹窗左侧的「记忆」分区，以及侧边栏「插件」→ Recollect → 组件行「recollect」。两处是同一份表单，可以调整全部选项：记忆开关与写入方式、记忆文本语言、是否与 Claude Code 共用目录、指令文件的措辞强度与排除规则、召回、后台提取和整理。保存后立即生效，并写入 profile 覆盖；当前对话里已经注入的内容会在下次刷新时更新。

「记忆」分区顶部是「当前加载情况」：选一个工作目录（默认取最近的根会话，排除子代理），列出会注入给模型的指令文件和记忆索引（类型与字符数），以及记忆目录里的主题文件（类型、描述、更新时间）。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 设置页：面板显示 Claude Code 的记忆目录和主题文件条数。「与 Claude Code 共用本项目」按 Git 根目录保存选择；关闭时会移除该项目的全部别名。全局共用、设置固定 `memory.directory` 或表单不可写时，开关不可用。要保留独立副本，点击「预览导入」，检查复制/相同/冲突数量后再「确认导入」；冲突保留现有文件。切换目录或配置版本变化会清除旧预览。导入后，使用同一目标记忆目录的根会话会在下一次请求时刷新。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 命令：| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `/memory` | 查看记忆状态、写入方式和已加载的全部指令与记忆文件 |
| `/pause-memory` | 在本会话中暂停或恢复记忆，状态在重启后保留 |
| `/remember <内容>` | 让模型把这句话存进记忆 |
| `/memory-import [all] [--dry-run]` | 复制 Claude Code 已有记忆；单项目已共用则拒绝，`all` 跳过按项目共用的目录，`--dry-run` 只预览 |
| `/dream` | 立即整理本项目的记忆目录（需先开启 dream） |

记忆关闭时禁止导入。全局共用时 `all` 拒绝执行；单项目只在该项目实际共用时拒绝。固定 `memory.directory` 优先于共用选择；仅配置 `shareProjects` 时，`all` 会把所有项目导入固定目录，不跳过任何项目。来源始终只读，目标同名文件不覆盖，索引按链接去重合并。命令输出随 `language` 使用中文或英文。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 配置：也可以直接编辑 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。手写覆盖会替换整个 config 对象，未写出的字段使用默认值：

```yaml
- id: recollect
  name: '@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect'
  config:
    language: zh          # 记忆文本与命令输出语言：zh / en

共用优先级：固定 `memory.directory` → 全局 `shareWithClaudeCode` → 按项目 `shareProjects` → 独立的 `memory.root/projects/<slug>/`。空或不完整的 `.git` 目录不再算仓库根；无有效仓库时使用工作目录。

全部字段见 [lib/config.js](lib/config.js)。环境变量 `DSH_RECOLLECT_DISABLE_MEMORY=1` 关闭记忆（设为 `0` 则强制开启），`DSH_RECOLLECT_DISABLE_INSTRUCTIONS=1` 关闭指令文件。

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 与 Claude Code 的差异：- 所有模型拿到同一套完整指导，不按模型名单降级或关闭记忆。
- 提示词都是独立编写的，提供中文和英文两套，不包含 Claude Code 的原文。召回使用独立实现的 BM25F。
- 除 `CLAUDE.md` 全套文件外，也读取 `AGENTS.md`、`.agents/rules`、`AGENTS.local.md`；同一目录内内容相同的文件只注入一次。
- 注入前清洗不可见字符和控制字符，并转义文件内容和路径中的 `</system-reminder>`。
- 新增 `/remember`。设置在「插件」页里调整；`/memory` 以文本形式显示当前状态和已加载的文件。
section: 与 Claude Code 的差异

本项目与 Anthropic 无关。"Claude Code" 只用来说明兼容的文件约定。
@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · 许可证：[MIT](LICENSE)

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Recollect：[中文](README.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Issues](https://github.com/kirkchinese/DSH-Recollect/issues) · Sibling project: [CiteCiter](https://github.com/kirkchinese/CiteCiter)

**Switch models and keep your memory.**

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Recollect：Recollect is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that provides a **Claude-Code-compatible memory system**. It follows Claude Code's conventions: layered `CLAUDE.md` files, `@import`, `.claude/rules`, and a persistent memory with `MEMORY.md` as its index. Every model (DeepSeek, GPT, Qwen, Claude, …) gets the same complete memory guidance, with no downgrade for models outside a vendor's own catalog.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Why：In Claude Code, the memory-writing guidance depends on the model. Models outside its catalog get a short version that drops the long-term duty, the "save immediately when asked" rule and all examples, so they rarely write memories on their own. Recollect gives every model guidance written independently for this project (in Chinese and English) together with the same file conventions, so that any model:

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Compatibility with Claude Code：| Area | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Instruction files | **Reads the same files**: `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/rules/`, project `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules/`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `@import`, `/etc/claude-code`, plus `AGENTS.md` |
| Memory format | **Same**: one file per memory with frontmatter (`name`, `description`, `metadata.type`), four types, `MEMORY.md` as the index |
| Memory storage | **Separate by default**: Recollect writes to `~/.dsh/memory/projects/<slug>/`, Claude Code to `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/`, with the same slug rule |
| Existing Claude Code memories | Copy them with `/memory-import` (`all` for every project, `--dry-run` to preview). The source is only read, existing files are never overwritten, and index lines are merged by link |
| One shared memory | Optional globally (`memory.shareWithClaudeCode: true`) or per project (`memory.shareProjects`). The panel's **Share this project with Claude Code** switch controls the current project; **Preview import → Confirm import** copies memories once instead. Sharing lets both programs edit the same files, including Claude Code

| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` and later (including the official Desktop; tested with `0.2.1-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.5`) | `0.5.0` |

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Installing on Windows：Install the npm package from PowerShell (the official Desktop also accepts this npm package on its Plugins page):

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect@0.5.0"
```

Restart DSH and reload the page. Known platform differences:

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Version support policy：`engines.dsh` sets only the lower bound `>=0.2.0-rc.2`, and DSH peer dependencies use open ranges. New DSH release candidates therefore are not blocked by installation checks. If a host interface changes, the affected feature may fail rather than the entire plugin being rejected because of a version ceiling. CI covers the two tested host versions above and Linux / Windows; an open range is not a promise that future interfaces never change.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · What it does：| Feature | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Instruction files | on | Loaded in this order: organization policy (`/etc/claude-code`); the user level (`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`, `~/.agents/AGENTS.md`, `~/.claude/rules`); then every directory from `/` down to the working directory (`CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md` with `@import` expanded in place up to 4 levels, then `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, then rules as recursive `.md` files, then `CLAUDE.local.md`/`AGENTS.local.md`). All files are concatenated without truncation; a single file over 4 MiB is skipped |
| Persistent memory | on | The system prompt carries the full writing guidance: four types, what not to save, the two-step save procedure, and access and verification rules. The first message carries the `MEMORY.md` index, truncated with a warning beyond 200 lines or 25 000 characters |
| Refresh | on | On resume only changed files are shown. When compaction summarizes the instructions away, they are re-injected in full. Directory changes and pause/resume also refresh them |
| Subdirectory discovery | on | Touching a file in a subdirectory injects that directory's instruction
@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · What it does：Memories live in `~/.dsh/memory/projects/<slug of the git root>/`, shared by all subdirectories and worktrees of a repository.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · What it does：**Writes adapt to the sandbox.** When the sandbox allows writing the memory directory, the model uses the built-in `write`/`edit`. When it does not (for example `workspace-write`, where the directory is outside the workspace), Recollect mounts `memory_list/read/write/edit/delete` and switches the guidance to match. These tools write only `.md` files inside the memory directory and refuse secrets. Nothing is written in a read-only sandbox.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Settings page：Two entry points share one form: the **Memory** section of the Settings dialog, and the Web sidebar's **Plugins** → Recollect → the `recollect` row. Adjust every option: memory on/off and write mode, the language of memory text, sharing with Claude Code, instruction wording and excludes, recall, background extraction and consolidation. Changes apply on save and are stored as a profile override; content already injected into a conversation updates at the next refresh.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Settings page：The Memory section opens with **What is loaded**: pick a working directory (defaulting to the latest root session, excluding subagents) to list its injected instruction files and memory index with type and size, and its memory topic files with type, description and update time.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Settings page：The panel also shows the Claude Code memory directory and topic count. **Share this project with Claude Code** saves the selection by Git root; turning it off removes every alias for that project. The switch is disabled when sharing globally, using a fixed `memory.directory`, or editing a read-only form. For an independent copy, choose **Preview import**, inspect copied/identical/conflicting counts, then **Confirm import**; conflicts keep existing files. Changing directory or configuration revision invalidates old previews. After import, root sessions using the target memory directory refresh on their next request.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Commands：| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/memory` | Memory status, write mode, and every loaded instruction and memory file |
| `/pause-memory` | Pause or resume memory for this session (kept across restarts) |
| `/remember <text>` | Ask the model to save `text` to memory |
| `/memory-import [all] [--dry-run]` | Copy Claude Code memories; refuse a shared current project, skip per-project shares in `all`, and preview with `--dry-run` |
| `/dream` | Consolidate this project's memory now (requires dream to be enabled) |

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Commands：Imports are refused while memory is disabled. Global sharing refuses `all`; a single-project import is refused only when that project actually shares memory. A fixed `memory.directory` overrides sharing: with only `shareProjects` configured, `all` imports every project into that fixed directory without skipping any. Sources stay read-only, existing target files are kept, and index lines are merged by link. Command output follows `language`.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Configuration：You can also edit the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` by hand. A hand-written override replaces the whole config object; omitted fields keep their defaults.

```yaml
- id: recollect
  name: '@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect'
  config:
    language: en          # memory text and command output: zh / en

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Configuration：Precedence: fixed `memory.directory` → global `shareWithClaudeCode` → per-project `shareProjects` → independent `memory.root/projects/<slug>/`. Empty or incomplete `.git` directories are not repository roots; without a valid repository, the working directory is used.

Every field is listed in [lib/config.js](lib/config.js). `DSH_RECOLLECT_DISABLE_MEMORY=1` turns memory off (`0` forces it on), and `DSH_RECOLLECT_DISABLE_INSTRUCTIONS=1` turns instruction files off.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Differences from Claude Code：- Every model gets the same complete guidance. Memory is never shortened or disabled based on the model name.
- All prompts are written independently for this project, with no Claude Code text, in Chinese and English. Recall uses an independent BM25F implementation.
- `AGENTS.md`, `.agents/rules` and `AGENTS.local.md` load alongside the `CLAUDE.md` family. Files with identical content in one directory are shown once.
- Invisible and control characters are stripped, and `</system-reminder>` in file content or paths is escaped.
- Adds `/remember`. Settings live on the Plugins page; `/memory` reports the current status and loaded files as text.

@kirkchinese/dsh-recollect README · Known limitations：- On a context overflow, DSH compacts and retries within the same step without the injection hook, so that single retry lacks the instruction block. The next step restores it.
- Headless mode exits right after the turn, so background extraction does not run there.
- The consolidation lock writes a PID and reads it back; it is not atomic. Do not run two host processes on one DSH home.

Recollect is not affiliated with Anthropic. "Claude Code" is used only to describe compatible file conventions.
